title: Outcome of a VwGH or VfGH decision (normalized_outcome annotation)
description: The outcome of one VwGH or VfGH decision of the pool (most decide on a remedy against a BVwG decision), by rules (config/outcomes/higher_courts.yaml). Spans are offsets into the decision's full_text.

register.description: The court's register as the RIS document number gives it (VwGH: the letter before the last two digits, F = Fr, deadline applications; VfGH: E, G, V, U, ...); it fixes the outcome for VwGH F (deadline_application) and VfGH G and V (norm_review).

outcome.description: annulled: the BVwG decision is set aside (VfGH: with a violated right); dismissed: the remedy fails on the merits (VfGH: no violation); declined: the VfGH declines to deal with the complaint; rejected: the remedy is inadmissible; discontinued; norm_review: a VfGH decision on a law or regulation (registers G and V, whatever the result); interim: suspensive effect only, a stay, or questions referred to the CJEU; legal_aid: legal aid only; deadline_application: a VwGH decision on a deadline application against the BVwG (register Fr, whatever the result); procedural: restitution or another procedural application; unrecognized.

partial.description: An annulment of part of the decision only.

transferred.description: The operative part transfers a complaint ('abgetreten'; the VfGH's to the VwGH).

revision_party.description: VwGH: who brought the revision (the BFA or a minister, or a party); VfGH: party.
